notes.quality_verdict: A smooth, steady rise with a forward push and a slight tilt down the alley; the scooter sinks out of the bottom of the frame, the fire escapes and lit windows come into view, the steam and wet reflections stay consistent. No cuts or flicker. The walls and windows revealed are invented by the model, not taken from the still, and the scooter changes shape slightly early on. 720p. Own rating 7/10, clearly better than the free LTX-2.3 prompt-only crane (5/10, partial).
